package PACKAGE

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/karl-tye/ktml"
	"github.com/karl-tye/ktml/dev"
	"github.com/karl-tye/ktml/dev/interp"
)

// This file is written by the interpreter parity harness
// (dev/interp/parity_test.go). It renders every scenario through the
// generated Go and through the interpreter and compares exact bytes, the
// number of writes, and the error, including after every possible write
// failure and cancellation point.

type ktmlParityScenario struct {
	component string
	name      string
	value     ktml.Component
}

func ktmlParityContent(label string) ktml.Component {
	return ktml.ComponentFunc(func(ctx context.Context, w io.Writer) error {
		_, err := io.WriteString(w, "<em>"+label+"</em>")
		return err
	})
}

var errKTMLParityWrite = errors.New("injected write failure")

type ktmlParityWriter struct {
	output   bytes.Buffer
	writes   int
	failAt   int
	cancelAt int
	cancel   context.CancelFunc
}

func (w *ktmlParityWriter) Write(p []byte) (int, error) { return w.write(string(p)) }

func (w *ktmlParityWriter) WriteString(s string) (int, error) { return w.write(s) }

func (w *ktmlParityWriter) write(s string) (int, error) {
	w.writes++
	if w.writes == w.failAt {
		return 0, errKTMLParityWrite
	}
	w.output.WriteString(s)
	if w.writes == w.cancelAt {
		w.cancel()
	}
	return len(s), nil
}

// ktmlParityDelegate is the delegation hook of the ktmldev public Render
// (ADR-0004) rendering through the interpreter program.
type ktmlParityDelegate struct{ program *interp.Program }

func (d ktmlParityDelegate) RenderComponent(ctx context.Context, w io.Writer, component ktml.Component, generated func(context.Context, io.Writer) error) error {
	return d.program.Render(ctx, w, component)
}

// ktmlParityMode is one way of entering a render: the root scope it starts
// in, and whether generated public Renders delegate to the interpreter.
type ktmlParityMode struct {
	name     string
	scope    string
	delegate bool
}

func ktmlParityModes() []ktmlParityMode {
	modes := []ktmlParityMode{{name: "untracked root"}}
	if ktmlParityDevelopment {
		modes = append(modes,
			ktmlParityMode{name: "registry root", scope: "@1"},
			ktmlParityMode{name: "delegated registry root", scope: "@1", delegate: true})
	}
	return modes
}

func ktmlParityRender(render func(context.Context, io.Writer) error, scope string, failAt, cancelAt int, canceled bool) (string, int, string) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	if scope != "" {
		ctx = dev.WithScope(ctx, scope)
	}
	defer cancel()
	if canceled {
		cancel()
	}
	w := &ktmlParityWriter{failAt: failAt, cancelAt: cancelAt, cancel: cancel}
	err := render(ctx, w)
	outcome, kind := "ok", "ok"
	if err != nil {
		kind = "error"
		var typed *ktml.RenderError
		if errors.As(err, &typed) {
			kind = strings.ReplaceAll(fmt.Sprintf("%s(partial=%v)", typed.Kind, typed.Partial), " ", "-")
			outcome = fmt.Sprintf("RenderError kind=%s component=%s input=%s key=%s partial=%v err=%v write=%v canceled=%v",
				typed.Kind, typed.Component, typed.Input, typed.Key, typed.Partial, typed.Err,
				errors.Is(err, errKTMLParityWrite), errors.Is(err, context.Canceled))
		} else {
			outcome = "error " + err.Error()
		}
	}
	return fmt.Sprintf("%s\nwrites=%d\n%s", outcome, w.writes, w.output.String()), w.writes, kind
}

func TestKTMLParity(t *testing.T) {
	program, err := interp.Load(ktmlParityRoot, interp.Options{Development: ktmlParityDevelopment})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("interp.Load() error = %v", err)
	}
	comparisons := 0
	rendered := make(map[string]bool)
	outcomes := make(map[string]int)
	scenarios := ktmlParityScenarios()
	for _, mode := range ktmlParityModes() {
		for _, scenario := range scenarios {
			t.Run(mode.name+"/"+scenario.component+"/"+scenario.name, func(t *testing.T) {
				generated := func(ctx context.Context, w io.Writer) error { return scenario.value.Render(ctx, w) }
				interpreted := func(ctx context.Context, w io.Writer) error { return program.Render(ctx, w, scenario.value) }
				compare := func(label string, failAt, cancelAt int, canceled bool) (int, string) {
					comparisons++
					want, writes, kind := ktmlParityRender(generated, mode.scope, failAt, cancelAt, canceled)
					got, _, _ := ktmlParityRender(interpreted, mode.scope, failAt, cancelAt, canceled)
					if got != want {
						t.Errorf("%s: interpreter differs from generated Go\n--- generated\n%s\n--- interpreted\n%s", label, want, got)
					}
					if mode.delegate {
						// The generated public Render handed to the hook
						// must render exactly as the compiled body did.
						restore := dev.SetRenderer(ktmlParityDelegate{program: program})
						delegated, _, _ := ktmlParityRender(generated, mode.scope, failAt, cancelAt, canceled)
						restore()
						if delegated != want {
							t.Errorf("%s: delegated Render differs from generated Go\n--- generated\n%s\n--- delegated\n%s", label, want, delegated)
						}
					}
					return writes, kind
				}
				writes, kind := compare("render", 0, 0, false)
				outcomes[kind]++
				if kind == "ok" {
					rendered[scenario.component] = true
				}
				compare("canceled before render", 0, 0, true)
				for at := 1; at <= writes; at++ {
					compare(fmt.Sprintf("write %d fails", at), at, 0, false)
					compare(fmt.Sprintf("canceled after write %d", at), 0, at, false)
				}
			})
		}
	}
	for _, scenario := range scenarios {
		if !rendered[scenario.component] {
			t.Errorf("no scenario of %s rendered without an error", scenario.component)
			rendered[scenario.component] = true
		}
	}
	kinds := make([]string, 0, len(outcomes))
	for kind, count := range outcomes {
		kinds = append(kinds, fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d", kind, count))
	}
	sort.Strings(kinds)
	t.Logf("PARITY package=PACKAGE development=%v components=%d scenarios=%d comparisons=%d outcomes=%s", ktmlParityDevelopment, len(rendered), len(scenarios), comparisons, strings.Join(kinds, ","))
}
